onential and hyperbolic time-decay factors and several nonlinear functions of A did not close the gap.

The best recorded candidate is the last one, `a + b·t + c·A + d·A² + e·t·A + f·A³ + g·t·A²`, with NMSE 3.56e-3. The simpler form `a + b·t + c·A + d·A² + e·t·A` reached 5.2e-3. I used all 14 calls.
